status: Layout/background source only; Canva native text field registration and actual export must be verified separately.

font.canvaNote: Font family availability is not confirmed. Canva editing tools expose size/weight but not font-family assignment. Verify Korean font visually in each master.

highlightPolicy.message: No fixed stripes beneath body lines. They become incorrect when copy wraps or changes. Native inline highlighting is not claimed.
highlightPolicy.futureRequirement: Compute exact phrase ranges and measured native text line geometry after every edit and autofill; validate actual Canva support before enabling.
highlightPolicy.fallback: A narrow accent bar outside the text box. It marks the paragraph region without claiming that a specific phrase is highlighted.

textLayoutPolicy.overflowAction: Report the exact field to the editor; shorten copy or explicitly choose a suitable layout. Never silently clip.
